references.label: Hellavator
references.description: The elevator alternates with its control target to hold three locks for Hellavator Multiball. During Multiball, ramps build the Jackpot and the elevator collects it.

references.label: Ghost targets
references.description: If Minion Multiball is active, shoot orbits to build its Jackpot. Use the ghost loop to trap balls, then clear the ghost targets to collect.

references.label: Mode scoop
references.description: The right scoop starts Photo Hunt after G-L-I-R is complete and starts Bumps in the Night after its required features are complete.

references.label: G-L-I-R lane
references.description: Use the flippers to move the pulsing G-L-I-R lane, then roll through that lane to apply the Ghost Burst multiplier to the next score.
